name: Here Be Monsters
source:
Here Be Monsters is a serialized adult visual novel set in a world of exploration, conspiracy, and adventure. You play as Alex, a doctor shipwrecked while in search of a cure to a deadly plague. Stranded in a foreign land populated almost entirely by monstergirls, Alex does what any rational human would do: try to screw as many of them as he can! 

[Edited from [url=https://hbm-dev.itch.io/here-be-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]

Full game was canceled and only a demo was released.
translation:
《Here Be Monsters》是一部连载的成人视觉小说，背景设定在一个充满探索、阴谋和冒险的世界中。你扮演亚历克斯，一名在寻找致命瘟疫治疗方法时遭遇海难的医生。亚历克斯被困在几乎全是怪物女孩的异国他乡，他做了任何理性人都会做的事：尝试尽可能多地搞砸她们！

[编辑自[url=https://hbm-dev.itch.io/here-be-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]

完整游戏被取消，仅发布了演示版。
